scope: Fixed b4/b8 local codec only; both implementations measured in same case/session paired blocks

statistics.unit: microseconds per call from elapsed_ms * 1000 / K
statistics.overall: Median, min and max of five session medians
statistics.p95: Block-average per-call latency p95; not request tail latency
statistics.paired_speedup: PyTorch session median / custom CUDA session median, same case and session
statistics.gain_classification: Descriptive: observed if every session reference p25 exceeds custom p75; not_observed if converse; otherwise inconclusive. No hypothesis test or data exclusion.
statistics.noise_rule: Any session GPU IQR/median > 0.10; slow observations retained; cross-session drift separately max/min
